transcript: Speaker A: पति की ऑफिस पार्टी में HR ने पूछा, 'So what do you do?' मैं बोली, 'I home काम.' HR मुस्कुराई और किसी और से बात करने लग गई। [At my husband's office party, the HR asked, 'So what do you do?' I said, 'I home work.' The HR smiled and started talking to someone else.] ... उस रात सब सो गए। मैं बाथरूम में बैठ के रोई। [That night everyone slept. I sat in the bathroom and cried.] ... उस रात फोन उठाया। 'English Seekho' ऐप डाउनलोड किया। ₹1 का ट्रायल था। [That night I picked up my phone. Downloaded the 'English Seekho' app. There was a 1 rupee trial.] ... अगली पार्टी में चुप मत बैठना, बोलो कॉन्फिडेंटली। [Don't sit silent at the next party, speak confidently.] Speaker B: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho. INSTALL NOW. [Disclaimer text in Hindi/English]
summary: An AI-animated narrative about a homemaker who feels deeply embarrassed at her husband's office party because she cannot speak English. She downloads the 'English Seekho' app, practices daily with its AI coach, and confidently converses at the next party, making her husband proud. The ad promotes a 1-rupee trial of the app.
